title: The Commingled Lot Margin Kept on Grain Run In With the House Bin
content:
Grain that has been run in with the house bin is not identified bushel for bushel, so a margin is kept for it when a receipt is reduced. This rule governs Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## What the tariff lays down

Where the programme commingles the lot with the house bin and bushels were taken in on more than two scale tickets, the wide commingled margin of 780 bushels is kept.

Where the programme commingles the lot with the house bin and bushels were taken in on one or two scale tickets, the light commingled margin of 260 bushels is kept.

And otherwise, the programme keeping the lot out of the house bin, no commingled margin is kept.

## Which programmes commingle

| Programme | Lot may be commingled with the house bin |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | yes |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | yes |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | no |

## The bands set out

| The programme | Scale tickets bushels were taken in on | Margin kept |
| --- | --- | --- |
| commingles the lot with the house bin | more than two | 780 |
| commingles the lot with the house bin | one or two | 260 |
| keeps the lot out of the house bin | any number | none |

The count is of the deposits the storage account shows for the agreement, one for each scale ticket taken into store.

## Worked margins, on hypothetical accounts

**A Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage whose account shows five deposits.** The programme commingles and more than two tickets were taken in, so 780 bushels are kept.

**A Grain Bank Deposit Account whose account shows two deposits.** The programme commingles and two tickets were taken in, so 260 bushels are kept.

**An Identity Preserved Segregated Storage whose account shows six deposits.** That programme keeps the lot out of the house bin, so no commingled margin is kept however many tickets were taken in.
